title: Spa Chemistry Test pH Level Leaderboard
dataSources: Hot Spring sessions (`hotspring:session`), spa chemistry logs (`spa:chemistry`), filter maintenance records (`spa:filter`), and spa energy usage (`spa:energy`).
app: Hot Spring session logs, spa chemistry test results, filter maintenance records, and energy consumption telemetry streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=spa:chemistry ph_level=*
| stats sum(ph_level) as total_value, avg(ph_level) as avg_value by spa_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks spa values by total and average ph level across spa chemistry test events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `ph_level` values for each spa chemistry test event and review total and average ph level by spa.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total ph level.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which spa shows the biggest ph level numbers in your spa chemistry test data.
